name: Strahler
description: Strahler stream order of a line network, from its topology. Adaptation of the QGIS Strahler3.0 plugin for RustGIS.
author: Ariel S. Rossi (RustGIS port); original QGIS plugin by Alexandre Delahaye

commands.label:
Color
Strahler Orders
commands.help: Colors each Strahler order of a layer: one class per order, in the colors given.
commands.params: {"layer": "layer name (optional: by default the active layer with an Order_Strahler field)", "color": "#RRGGBB list, comma separated (optional)"}

tools.name: Help
tools.summary: Shows a table with the steps for using Strahler Order.

tools.name: Strahler Order
tools.summary: Adds a layer whose segments carry their Strahler order. Segments must meet at their ends; multipart lines are skipped.

params.name: outlet
params.label: Outlet (latitude,longitude of the root's free end)
params.help: Latitude and longitude in degrees (WGS 84), written as lat,lon. It must be a free end: a point where the river meets nothing else.

params.name: tolerance
params.label: Snap tolerance (degrees)
params.help: The outlet snaps to the nearest segment end within this distance. 0.0001 degrees is about 11 m.
